intro.title: Jack Bush
intro.lead: I'm a design and product leader who loves making things.
intro.body: Since 2005 I've built websites, apps, platforms, teams, design systems, AI agents, instruments, a brain-machine interface, exhibitions, furniture, and a van. I care about quality, accessibility, delight, and contributing to the human toolbox.

projects.name: Sprig
projects.description: Botanical studies. Be taken on an arboreal tour, or click the settings cog and invent some plants. A bit like a god.

projects.name: Zola
projects.description: Build more accessible products. Each card describes a person's experience and the needs a design should accommodate.

projects.name: Risolino
projects.description: Make riso-style prints. Customise the ink blending, shading mode and registration for some analogue charm.

projects.name: Atlas Nights
projects.description: Spend a night star-gazing in the High Atlas. Choose constellation maps from regional sky cultures.

projects.name: Chromist
projects.description: Get your colours right. Build palettes for modern devices, see how they appear on old screens, audit accessibility against the next standards (WCAG 3.0).

projects.name: Metty
projects.description: Interface prototype for a robotic meditation timer, styled like a record player. Hardware build in progress.

projects.name: Blackstar
projects.description: An undulating black orb with a burning halo. Open the settings pane to design your own void.

projects.name: Albums
projects.description: Old-fashioned photo albums. Because social media is a mess, but it's nice to show your mum what you've been doing.

projects.name: Carver
projects.description: Write in convenient markdown, export as beautiful PDF. Minimal by design, private by default, delightful by nature.

projects.name: Zen and the Art of Bikepacking Maintenance
projects.description: Photos for an essay on The Radavist about gumption, romantic thinking, quality, and bikepacking across Europe.

projects.name: Mindflow
projects.description: Animated graphics that respond to your brain waves: focus to overlap the rings, relax to calm the outlines.

projects.name: Seeing Britain
projects.description: Learning my adoptive home by visiting every county. Mostly done by bicycle, tracked on an interactive map.

projects.name: Quadra
projects.description: Make QR codes without having your data scraped. Highly customisable, ISO-compliant and ad-free.

projects.name: Geode
projects.description: An experiment in browser-based ray tracing. Open the settings to grow your own crystals.

roles.description: Owned product, design, research and product marketing. Rebuilt a pioneering suite of battery traceability tools as one simpler, self-serve platform, to compete as regulation softened and the market commoditised.
listItems: Packaged the platform into two off-the-shelf propositions, setting sales up for repeatable deals instead of bespoke solutions
Rebuilt the platform API-first on AWS and open source, with a data lake and full API parity, cutting running costs 25%
Addressed scaling bottlenecks: Cut back-of-house config time 70%, shipped self-serve API setup tool with AI assistant
Restructured product and engineering into cross-functional, stream-aligned teams

roles.description: Led design of OVO's consumer app and digital experience for 4m UK households, also owning the design system and accessibility.
listItems: Rebuilt the customer app from information architecture up, based on mental model research, growing users from 200k to 500k and doubling engagement
Brought every customer product onto one design system at WCAG 2.2 AA, with open clinics and team-wide training

roles.description: First hire at a start-up using tools for independent tradespeople to build a network it could route jobs to. Built and led a design team covering research, service design, product design and brand.
listItems: Conceived an automated booking service from ethnographic research, converted 82% from email to booking
Scaled from four local pilot users to a 1000+ engineer UK-wide network completing 200k jobs/year
Implemented ride-alongs, with every colleague spending a day in the field

caseStudies.label: Designing trade tools in the field

roles.description: Led research and development into how emerging technologies (electronic signatures, blockchain, smart contracts and payments) could make legal protection more accessible.
listItems: Designed Rocket Wallet, a payment protection service that released funds based on contract terms, taking it to private beta with partners

roles.description: Set up the product and design function at an accelerator-stage start-up, leading it through growth to a $10.4m Series A.
listItems: Built the first decentralised platform for tracing provenance data across supply chains, securing 2m+ diamonds
Used it to digitally track the first diamond across mining, cutting, polishing and certification, to a ring in a shop

roles.description: Full-spectrum product consultancy covering research, propositions, prototyping, user testing and engineering. Projects included B2B platforms, marketing websites and experiences (VR, game, exhibition).
listItems: Won: Best Exhibition Design at London Design Week (2015)

roles.description: Ran the workshop for an on-demand prototyping and manufacturing service covering NZ and Australia.
listItems: Reduced order turnaround from 10 days to 48 hours
Cut material costs 25% by renegotiating with existing suppliers

roles.description: Found and documented Vishnu shrines in the Kathmandu valley, narrating local myths about the origins of the cosmos, and integrated into a series of drawings.
